description: Require Python dependency version specifiers (requirements.txt, pyproject.toml) to be pinned to an exact resolved version, not a floating range, unconstrained bare name, or unpinned git/URL ref.
appliesTo: requirements.txt (including files recursively included via -r/-c) and pyproject.toml's [project.dependencies], [project.optional-dependencies.*], and Poetry's [tool.poetry.dependencies] / [tool.poetry.group.*.dependencies] — checked at add/bump time and on existing trees

policy.description: A version specifier must resolve to exactly one immutable artifact: an exact PEP 440 version (==1.2.3 or ===1.2.3), a Poetry bare-string exact version, or a git/URL ref pinned to a commit SHA. Ranges, unconstrained bare names, and mutable refs are rejected.
policy.rationale: Python supply-chain attacks land the same way npm's do: an unconstrained or ranged specifier (a bare 'requests' with no operator, or '>=1.2.3') lets pip/Poetry silently resolve to whatever is newest at install time, including a newly compromised release. An exact pin means a compromised release sits unused until someone deliberately bumps the version, ideally through this plugin's OSV + license gate.
policy.exceptions: None by default. A temporary range must be documented in the PR and re-pinned before merge.

pinned: Exact PEP 440 version (package==1.2.3, prerelease/post/dev/local segments allowed)
git/hg ref with a commit SHA (7-40 hex chars) after '@'
URL requirement verified with --hash=sha256:... content pinning
floating: Bare package name with no version operator at all (unconstrained — the worst case, not a pass)
Multiple comma-separated specifiers, even if bounded both sides
== with a wildcard operand (package==1.2.*) — a prefix-match range despite the == operator
git/hg/svn/bzr ref with a branch, tag, or no ref
Plain URL requirement with no VCS ref and no --hash
Editable installs of a VCS ref without a commit SHA (-e does not exempt VCS mutability)

exemptPrefixes.note: Reported for awareness, never failed on — not fetched from a public registry the same way this policy's threat model targets.

classification.outOfScopeThisPass: SVN/bzr numeric-revision pinning is not specially recognized; such refs are conservatively classified as floating unless they happen to look hex. poetry.lock is not parsed — manifests only.
